title: Stalk nonvanishing equals the complement of the zero-locus support
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $s$ a global section. The set $\{x:s_x\notin\mathfrak m_x M_x\}$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] is the complement of the support of the zero scheme [def-pc-zero-scheme] of the morphism $\mathcal O_X\to M$, $a\mapsto as$. No quasi-compactness or nonemptiness is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a trivializing affine neighbourhood V and free generator e. The map r ↦ r e_x on the stalk is bijective: every stalk element has a section representative after shrinking inside V (TopCat.Presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq), and IsFreeGenerator.exists_smul_eq gives surjectivity. For injectivity, represent both scalars locally; equality of their images is equality of germs, so shrink by TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq and use IsFreeGenerator.smul_left_injective. The compatibility is PresheafOfModules.germ_smul and germ_res_apply. This is the proved private helper bijective_smul_germ.

Write s|V=f e using IsFreeGenerator.coeff_smul. The preceding bijection says span(e_x)=top. Submodule.mem_smul_span_singleton and injectivity show s_x∈maximalIdeal times the stalk iff f_x∈maximalIdeal. IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal and mem_nonunits_iff identify its negation with f_x being a unit. Scheme.mem_basicOpen identifies this with x∈D(f).

homOfGlobalSection_app_one identifies the morphism coefficient with f. basicOpen_coeff_eq (ClearDenominators, proved in the source library using Hom.ideal_zeroLocus) identifies D(f)=V intersect the complement of the zero-locus support. Since x∈V, this proves the set equality pointwise.
